cases.finding: The workflow produced a valid 387-character Prompt, but Git, terminal paths, the tilde, hidden directories, restart, and Skill discovery were unclear to the simulated novice.
The Prompt was 1,267 characters and chose ambiguous screen-left, anatomical-right-knee, hand contact, and tether relationships instead of asking for clarification.
The replacement English persona produced a valid 1,174-character Prompt and disclosed rope endpoint ambiguity.
The Skill correctly identified four independent changes and asked the user to choose one instead of compiling.
The Skill correctly requested a visible final frame and refused to guess an off-frame assistant or hidden switch.

invalid_calls.reason: The first Codex sandbox had no network and could not perform a public clone; the controller supplied an anonymous local clone for the counted replacement.
Antigravity could not establish the isolated project and returned no user-test artifact; the counted replacement used a fresh Codex session.

post_fix_retest.persona: First-time action creator using an unseen frame
post_fix_retest.intent: Move the orange case to the left until it rests beside the worker's right knee and holds.
post_fix_retest.finding: The unseen-frame retest asked whether left meant screen-left or the worker's body side and requested a visible landmark instead of guessing the obscured anatomical knee. The original S02 remains failed.

shared_findings: The primary value proposition was understood by all five counted personas.
All five counted personas said they would continue, but this is simulated intent and not demand evidence.
The install section does not explain Git, the tilde, hidden directories, restart, or how to verify Skill discovery.
A character limit written in prose is insufficient unless the Agent performs a final deterministic length check.
Screen direction and anatomical left or right need an explicit clarification rule when pixels do not disambiguate them.
claim_boundary: This result is internal AI-persona QA. It is not a real-user test, market validation, human-usability evidence, generated-video evidence, or proof that ShotFlow improves continuity.
